'''Wolfredo Wildpret de la Torre''' (16 September 1933 – 13 March 2026) was a Spanish scientist and botanist.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Wolfredo Wildpret de la Torre - EnciclopediaGuanche |url=https://guanches.org/Wolfredo_Wildpret_de_la_Torre |access-date=10 April 2026 |website=guanches.org |language=es}}</ref>
[[File:Colección Retratos Wolfredo Wildpret de la Torre 03.JPG|thumb|Wildpret de la Torre in 2013]]

== Life and career ==
Wolfredo Wildpret de la Torre was born in [[Santa Cruz de Tenerife]] on 16 September 1933. He was known for his facet as a naturalist, conservationist, popularizer and promoter of interest in mycology among the bulk of the [[Canary Islands]] population, as well as for cataloging numerous endemic species of the Canary Islands.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Avisos |first=Diario de |date=13 March 2026 |title=Fallece el científico tinerfeño Wolfredo Wildpret, eminencia de la botánica en Canarias |url=https://diariodeavisos.elespanol.com/2026/03/fallece-wolfredo-wildpret-botanico-canarias-tenerife/ |access-date=10 April 2026 |language=es}}</ref>

Throughout his life, he published numerous books on the flora and fauna of the Canary Islands.<ref>{{Cite web |title=La Filarmónica, Wolfredo Wildpret y Antonio Tejera, Premios Canarias 2011 |url=http://www.daciencia.com/2013/01/28/wolfredo-wilpred-y-fernandez-caldas-medallas-de-oro-de-la-facultad-de-biologia/}}</ref>
[[File:PlacaWolfredo.jpg|thumb|The street dedicated to Wilfredo at the [[University of La Laguna]]]]
In 2009, the [[University of La Laguna]] dedicated a street to him at the Anchieta campus.<ref>{{Cite web |date=14 November 2009 |title=La ULL dedica una calle al profesor Wolfredo Wildpret |url=https://www.abc.es/espana/canarias/abci-dedica-calle-profesor-wolfredo-wildpret-200911140300-1131475646681_noticia.html |access-date=10 April 2026 |website=Diario ABC |language=es}}</ref>

Wildpret de la Torre died on 13 March 2026, at the age of 92.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 March 2026 |title=Don Wolfredo Wildpret de la Torre - Esquelas en Diario de Avisos |url=https://diariodeavisos.elespanol.com/esquelas/2026/03/13/40017/ |access-date=10 April 2026 |language=es}}</ref>
